title: Daughter Erased My Name From The Tea Lounge And Sold It For $980K. So I Sued And Now I Own It.
description: My daughter secretly erased my name from our notarized tea lounge agreement, sold the brand for $980,000, and mailed me a $5,000 'consulting fee.' I sued for fraud, won the trademark, and now my tea tins link to her court docket while she hand-sorts leaves wearing a 'Brewed Betrayal' badge. #BetrayedByDaughter #SteepedInLies #TrademarkRevenge
thumb_text: MY DAUGHTER ERASED ME, NOW I OWN HER TRADEMARK
pinned_comment: If your daughter forged you off a $980K tea brand and mailed you a $5K check, would you have sued and put the court docket on every tin? Tell me what you'd do if your own child betrayed you like this.

thumb_lines.text: SHE FORGED MY NAME OFF THE DEED
